en: The black-and-white postcard displays a panoramic view of a historic European city with a prominent castle-like building featuring towers, as well as multiple church spires towering above the old town's dense rooftops. There's a long road or bridge in the foreground leading into a wooded area and the city beyond. The architecture is typical of northern or eastern Europe, combining medieval and 19th-century styles. There is handwritten text on the upper edge, mirrored and possibly in Cyrillic script.
